C1525.title: Hacker Phished for $48 Million via Malicious Approval Contract Attack
C1525.summary: A hacker who previously targeted the UXLINK project fell victim to a phishing site posing as a white-hat negotiation platform. The attacker signed a malicious smart contract granting unlimited token approval, resulting in the transfer of approximately $48 million in digital assets from their wallet.
